decisions.why: capnography accessories, airway therapy systems, respiratory therapy systems and heat/moisture exchangers are respiratory therapy & circuit products
convective warming blankets/warmer devices and blood/fluid warmer sets are patient warming & temperature management equipment
cardiac output sensors and disposable/integrated pressure transducers are sensors & probes rather than the monitor units themselves
closed system transfer devices (Chemoclave, Chemolock) and a drug reconstitution transfer device are pharmacy aseptic preparation equipment
antimicrobial barrier caps and a needlefree connector both named for haemodialysis catheters are haemodialysis products
